answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the Proof of Agent economy enforces cryptographic stake burning where registering n identities requires burning stake scaling quadratically as O(n²), imposing superlinear cost on adversaries. Valid nodes anchor identities in a global coordination atlas, while unverified identities vanish into a cryptographic nebula. High-frequency whisper channels require burned gas tokens, making forged identity swarms mathematically unprofitable.
